title: Counting Colored Trees
summary: We consider the enumeration of plane trees (rooted ordered trees) whose vertices are colored according to a specific coloring rule that prescribes which possible pairs of colors can occur as the colors of a parent vertex and its child. This general construction covers many different examples that have been studied in the literature. Some general necessary and sufficient conditions for two different coloring rules to result in the same counting sequence are established.
